description.value: Q at the Empress is a refined raw bar and modern seafood restaurant on the ground floor of Victoria's iconic Empress Hotel, with sweeping views of the Inner Harbour. The menu draws heavily on BC and Vancouver Island's coastal waters and local farms, featuring freshly shucked West Coast oysters, Dungeness crab, hand rolls, and sustainable seafood. Live music is a nightly feature, and the restaurant sits at the heart of Victoria's busiest waterfront tourist district on Government Street.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 87m; rack at 88m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; rack at 95m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at qattheempress.com is fully accessible and provides address (721 Government St, Victoria, BC V8W 1W5) and phone ((250)-384-8111) not present in OSM tags. The menu page explicitly labels many items as 'plant based,' 'dairy free,' and 'gluten free,' confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM alt_name 'Empress Dining Room' may reflect an outdated or informal name; the website uses only 'Q at the Empress.' This could cause confusion with other Empress Hotel dining references.
OSM cuisine tag is 'american' but the menu is distinctly Pacific Northwest seafood and raw bar — a minor inaccuracy in OSM.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, upscale restaurant in a prime Victoria Inner Harbour location that a touring cyclist would find genuinely useful as a food stop or destination meal; strong vegetarian/GF options and central location on Government St make it a legitimate Food & Drink directory entry.
